audience: businesses that collect signed waivers for tours, classes and events with WaiverFile

useCases.title: See who signed a waiver for an event
useCases.text: The AI lists upcoming events or events in a date range, then reads the waivers of one event: who signed, when, and the participants.

useCases.title: Find a signed waiver by name, email or phone
useCases.text: The AI searches signed waivers by a signer's name, email or phone, or by a booking reference id, and reads one waiver with its form data.

useCases.title: Count or list the waivers of a date range
useCases.text: The AI counts the waivers in a date range, lists them, and reads flat export rows with custom form fields as columns.

useCases.title: Check who opted in to or out of SMS marketing
useCases.text: The AI lists the phone numbers that opted in during a date range, or those that opted out.

useCases.title: Create or update an event
useCases.text: The AI creates an event with name, start and end time, category and waiver forms, or updates one. Updating replaces the whole event, so it reads the event first.

useCases.title: Invite managers to an event
useCases.text: The AI invites people by email address to manage one event. WaiverFile sends each of them an email, with your optional message.
